description: Search open akay.ie trade offers by keyword, EAN, size ("70cl", "6x70cl"), ABV or duty status, with optional website filters. Returns listed sell prices per case and per unit in each offer's own currency (EUR, USD or GBP), pack, duty status, Incoterm, location and stock. Paged: up to 25 per page, 10 pages per query.

category.description: Category, e.g. Spirits, Beer, Soft Drinks, Wine, Confectionery (see list_categories)

duty_status.description: Duty status as listed. T1 = non-EU (third-country) status goods under customs transit; T2 = EU-status goods that can move within the EU under excise duty suspension (e.g. with an eAD in EMCS). Both T1 and T2 are held in bond with duty suspended: neither is duty paid. Bonded, On Floor and Duty Paid are shown exactly as listed on akay.ie.

location.description: Warehouse location or country as listed, e.g. Netherlands, Latvia

query.description: Keywords, EAN, size or pack, e.g. "Jameson 70cl T2"
